notes.title: Prologue Has Its Own Page Now!
notes.content:
Happy new year to everyone!

This year will be exciting for me as two games I’m developing right now will be released!
Besides GunBlocks I’m porting an old platformer I was involved in 2006.
Follow https://twitter.com/tons_of_bits to stay tuned for Mission in Snowdriftland.

GunBlocks has its own little release today as the prologue got its own Steam page! That means it will be permanently available to play, it has achievements and you can review it.

So it would be really nice to take a look and write down your thoughts in a review. Thanks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492720

The release for chapter 1 will be late spring or early summer hopefully.

Have a good one!
 - Steve

notes.title: Patch 0.8.26
notes.content:
After a lot of input from the community, here’s the next patch. Sorted out some heavy bugs and added a few particle animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38118280/10430cd2441fadd2cea148154050c7acf1ee8c19.gif[/img]

[u]Bug reporting[/u]
You’re still very welcome to report all sorts of bugs and feedback. It turns out that the in-game report tool is really handy. But you’re also welcome on our [url=https://discord.gg/HCKKv9Y]Discord server[/url]


[h3]Changelog[/h3]

[i]0.8.26[/i]
 - Fixed freezing after player shoot to the left side in the spaceship
 - Fixed freezing when the third tetromino in spaceship was placed with a wrong rotation 
 - Fixed freezing after first guardian shot
 - Renamed Control Stone to Nexus Stone

[i]0.8.25[/i]
 - Start HP for Rookie reduced from 3 to 2. It’s more challenging now ;-)
 - Changed slightly the Health bar design
 - Spaceship music is stereo. Was strange to hear it just from the right side
 - Added alert sfx for the outpost intro
 - Added alert sfx for the computer
 - Added stereo position for sound effects
 - Gundians sprites polished
 - Added ambient particle effects
 - Added tree grow animation

notes.title: Start the journey with the free-to-play prologue!
notes.content:
Hi there,
My name is Steve and I’m the creator of GunBlocks. As I’m not alone, friends are helping me especially with music, sfx, dialogues, ideas, and testing.

GunBlocks has a long evolution as it’s an ambiguous mix of many mechanics inspired by games like Tetris, Worms, and many others. This makes creating intuitive controls challenging. To make the learning process fun, we added a lot of humor and integrated the tutorial right into the story.  

In the Prologue/demo you are introduced to the main mechanics of the game. Position tetrominos strategically to overcome obstacles and navigate the terrain. Scavenge for new blocks and power-ups to help defeat enemies and uncover strange mysteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38118280/03ea9f926134649034dc99bbffe5bf8d3ae04f1c.gif[/img]

The prologue is also the start of the story which will be continued in chapter 1, available in spring 2021. Many more chapters will follow...

As the prologue is still in testing phase, we’re collecting feedback over the in-game report tool or on our [url=https://discord.gg/HCKKv9Y]Discord channel[/url].

Any feedback is welcome, especially if the game mechanics are understandable and the story is fun. But of course we’re happy for every reported bug or game idea!

And now get on board the BallEX ship and enjoy your first day as a delivery guy :-)

 - Steve

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492720

notes.title: Status quo
notes.content:
[i]Hi! I’m Steve, the main developer of GunBlocks. [/i]

After a long period of silence, we’re ready to gather feedback from a wider audience! But first a little about the history of GunBlocks so far.

[h2]History[/h2]

The core idea for the game is based on a dream which I had in 2011. In the dream I’ve played a 1:1 Tetris multiplayer session but with somehow more functional tetrominos. It’s a bit hard to describe but at the bottom part of the game was a lot going on like small figures are moving and stuff. Hard to remember for me now, but I was really hyped as I woke up. That was the beginning of a long way of changing and evolving prototypes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38118280/92aea57f6d46a902abe5a6068af970c3ab1e546e.jpg[/img]

The first big step was a pre-alpha demo in 2014. It was available on our website and on [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/GunBlocks/31630]Game Jolt[/url]. We’ve received a lot of positiv and helpful feedback. It was quite motivating to keep the project going on, even though we had little time for development. 

What makes the development most challenging is the hard to understand genre mix of many game mechanics. We tried to make the explanation as interesting as possible. So the tutorial is already a part of the story.

After fleshing out all of the important parts of the game like level design, enemies, and puzzles we need your input now. We’ve prepared a playable part of the game which is called the Prologue. It’s much more enhanced than the old pre-alpha demo from 2014.

Since it’s still an alpha version you can only find it on our [url= https://discord.gg/HCKKv9Y]Discord server[/url] for now.
As soon as the Prologue is polished enough, we’ll make it playable as an official demo on Steam!

[h2]What’s the current status of the Prologue?[/h2]

It’s not yet tested on many computers so technical issues may happen.
Most of the sound effects are placeholders and the dialogues need proofreading.
Besides that it’s in a (hopefully) good shape :-)

The most interesting question for us is if the game mechanic is understandable and fun. Even though if it's just a short part of the game, most of the vital parts are presented.

Let us know if you enjoyed the game and help us finding the bugs!

- Steve
